head: 805c204a9dbfb5b8128de8f70c9f3fbd6d6583f9

source.ref: https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak/pull/38723; hand-checked 2026-09-29; merged with the bug, fixed upstream by b807a45091c (#43132)

rationale: The change adds a switch case right after one that had no break because it used to be last, so every guide that sets a priority also has its tile hidden. ocra reported it in all four runs on this pull request. ADR-0036: kept; the AACR-Bench reference, written by a model, asks for a break after the last case rather than the one that falls through; upstream added the missing break in 2025-10; base set to the merge base.

expect.concern: The priority case has no break, so it falls through into the new tileVisible case: a guide that sets priority also calls setTileVisible(Boolean.parseBoolean(null)), which is false, and its tile is hidden.
